games.name: BloxyWare's Disasters
games.desc:
🔥 Welcome to BloxyWare's Disasters! 🔥
Run, fight, and outlast the most chaotic and epic disasters ever! Use everything to your advantage, earn points, and do whatever it takes to survive. Good luck, and don't die!

🦆 Join the "BloxyWare" group to receive a FREE Epic Duck Gear in-game! 🦆

⚔️ GEAR UP:
Don't just stand there! Spend your hard-earned points to buy powerful items:
• 🏹 Weapons: Melee, Ranged, and Explosives to fight back against NPC disasters!
• 🛡️ Utility: Speed Coils, Healing Items, and tools to outsmart death.
• 🍔 Fun Items: Burgers, Drinks, Ducks, and more to survive with style.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:
• 🌪️ Pure Chaos: Random disasters mixed with unpredictable round modifiers!
• 🗳️ Map Voting: You and the server decide where the next chaos strikes.
• 😈 Be the Disaster: Use Robux to force specific disasters and modifiers.
• 🥇 Milestones: Earn unique badges for your survival... and your deaths too!

👍 Leave a Like and Favorite if you enjoy the game! It helps a lot!

games.name: Ashwood: SURVIVAL
games.desc:
Even ashes can burn again…

It burned in the fire. The radiation brought it back.
Now it hates the light that reminds it of death.

Team up. Fight back. It only makes IT angrier.
So come prepared — there’s always someone selling hope.

⸻

👀 Ashwood is a survival game focused on PvE, with optional PvP.
Survive the night, buy weapons, fight IT — or other players.

⚠️ This game is in Early Access / Active Development.
You may encounter bugs, glitches, and unfinished content.

👍 Thanks for your support — it means a lot to us. We appreciate your understanding!

⸻

Controls:

	•	Map — M
	•	Push — F
	•	Block — T (HOLD)
	•	Glory Kill — G
	•	Sprint — LShift (HOLD)
	•	Crouch — C (HOLD)
	•	Camera Mode — Q
	•	Camera Lock — L/R Ctrl
        •	Whistle — X
        •	Rear View — R
